member.name: T:ECommerce.Api.Constants.RateLimitingPolicies
member.summary: Contains constants for rate limiting policy names used throughout the application. These policies define different rate limiting strategies for API endpoints.

member.name: F:ECommerce.Api.Constants.RateLimitingPolicies.FixedWindow
member.summary: Fixed window rate limiting policy. This policy allows a fixed number of requests per specified time window.
member.example: Configuration might allow 100 requests per minute using this policy.

member.name: F:ECommerce.Api.Constants.RateLimitingPolicies.SlidingWindow
member.summary: Sliding window rate limiting policy. This policy allows a fixed number of requests per time window, but the window slides continuously rather than resetting at fixed intervals. This provides smoother rate limiting compared to fixed window.
member.example: Configuration might allow 100 requests per minute with a sliding window, where requests are counted in overlapping time segments.

member.name: F:ECommerce.Api.Constants.RateLimitingPolicies.TokenBucket
member.summary: Token bucket rate limiting policy. This policy allows bursts of requests up to a maximum capacity while maintaining a steady average rate over time.

member.name: F:ECommerce.Api.Constants.RateLimitingPolicies.Concurrency
member.summary: Concurrency rate limiting policy. This policy limits the number of simultaneous requests rather than requests per time period.

member.summary: Provides authentication and authorization endpoints including user registration, login, logout, token refresh, email confirmation, password reset, and two-factor authentication.

member.name: M:ECommerce.Api.Controllers.Auth.AuthController.RefreshAccessToken
member.summary: Refreshes the access token using the refresh token stored in cookies.
member.remarks: This endpoint is typically used by clients when the access token expires. The refresh token must be valid, active, and not expired. A new short-lived access token is returned and set in cookies.
member.returns: - 200 with new access token if refresh token is valid. - 401 if refresh token is invalid or expired.

member.name: M:ECommerce.Api.Controllers.Auth.AuthController.Refresh
member.summary: Issues a new refresh token, replacing the old one.
member.remarks: Refresh token rotation helps reduce the impact of token theft. A new refresh token is generated and stored, while the old one becomes invalid.
member.returns: - 200 with new refresh token if the old one is valid. - 401 if old refresh token is invalid or expired.

member.name: T:ECommerce.Api.Extentions.RateLimitingExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods for configuring rate limiting policies in the application.

member.name: M:ECommerce.Api.Extentions.RateLimitingExtensions.AddRateLimiters(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection)
member.summary: Adds and configures multiple rate limiting policies to the service collection.
member.param: The to add the rate limiter to.
member.returns: The same service collection so that multiple calls can be chained.
member.remarks:
Configures four different rate limiting strategies:
: Fixed window policy (5 requests per 5 seconds)
: Sliding window policy (4 requests per 10 seconds with 3 segments)
: Concurrency policy (5 simultaneous requests)
: Token bucket policy (10 token limit, 5 tokens replenished every 10 seconds)
All policies return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when the limit is exceeded.
